data.arc: AstraZeneca began mid‑2025 with strong revenue growth in India, driven by expanding oncology and personalized‑medicine opportunities. By late 2025 the company faced strategic headwinds, including a failed COPD trial and a move to list shares in New York, while simultaneously showcasing breakthrough ADC efficacy. Early 2026 brought mixed regulatory pressures—a landmark legal ruling in Spain and heightened US antitrust scrutiny—alongside a major manufacturing investment in the United States.
